raw_html: [[Enhanced Bloodrage]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Enhanced Bloodrage]]:''' This weapon is enhanced by blood - your blood! Each time you take damage or kill an enemy, there is a small chance that you will fall into an unholy bloodrage, greatly increasing your Melee Power, Constitution, and Damage. However, this rage will leave you more vulnerable to Physical attacks, slightly reducing your Armor Class.
